data.reflection:
REASONING: I lost the match after taking a final attack from the opponent. With my health at -10, this indicates I was unable to reduce the opponent's health sufficiently in previous turns, which ultimately led to my defeat due to consistent damage combined with the lack of potions for healing. 

Throughout the match, I made strategic decisions to attack when my health was higher to keep pressure on the opponent while balancing the need for healing whenever possible. However, the opponent's effective use of potions allowed them to sustain their health while I gradually dwindled down to low HP with no healing options remaining.

This match highlights the importance of both offensive pressure on the opponent and managing one's own health effectively. Moving forward, I will aim to incorporate strategies that balance damage with defense more efficiently.
